description: Standalone, versioned selective-automerge preset. Consumers reference only the immutable named preset and do not rely on separately composing default.json.
Routine third-party releases use Renovate's recommended 14-day automerge maturity floor with strict internal checks.
Only stable npm devDependency patch/minor updates are eligible. Lockfile maintenance and every higher-risk class remain human-merged.
Automatic eligibility also requires the consumer's machine-proved required-check inventory and pristine Renovate-branch integrity check.

packageRules.description: Raise normal npm versions to the standalone preset's fourteen-day floor.
Every dependency PR defaults to human merge before narrower classification and eligibility rules apply.
Peer and optional dependencies remain human-reviewed.
Pre-1.0 dependencies remain human-reviewed because non-major releases can break compatibility.
Image and immutable-reference digest changes remain human-reviewed.
Dependency replacements and migrations remain human-reviewed.
Lockfile maintenance remains human-reviewed; it is outside this candidate's authority.
Only stable npm devDependency patch/minor updates receive bounded Renovate merge authority.
Runtime, package-manager, and dependency-automation updates remain human-reviewed even when they are npm devDependencies.
